verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Pipedream Connect/MCP handles built-in user authentication, OAuth-style token storage, and refresh automatically with no developer implementation required, and credentials are encrypted at rest and never exposed to models; users can also revoke access. This directly matches the story's requirement for platform-run OAuth, vaulted encrypted credentials, and automatic refresh. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of token refresh behavior and encryption implementation beyond vendor docs.
